Counsel for Applicant :- Atul Verma,Hari Krishna Verma
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Subhash Vidyarthi,J.
1.

Heard Sri Atul Verma, the learned counsel for the applicant as well as Sri Rakesh Kumar Singh,
the learned A.G.A. for the State and Sri Praveen Kumar Yadav, Advocate who has put in appearance on behalf of the informant and filed his vakalatnama, which is taken on record.

2. The instant application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No.
413 of 2023, under Section 406, 506, 420, 467, 468, 471 I.P.C., registered at Police Station Deva,
District Barabanki.

3. The aforesaid case has been registered on the basis of F.I.R. lodged on 25.05.2023 against four persons, including the applicant, alleging that the informant had purchased a residential plot from co-accused Dhirendra Pratap Dubey, Proprietor/Director of M/s Paravinsal Infra Solution Company and by means of a sale deed dated 05.10.2016 and the informant's name was mutated on the basis of the sale deed but subsequently, it transpired that the land in question was a part of public passage.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The F.I.R requests that the suitable relief be granted to the informant as per law.
Regarding the applicant, only this much is stated that he had acted as a middleman for transaction.
4. In the affidavit filed in support of the bail application, it has been stated that the applicant is innocent and he has been falsely implicated in the present case.
The applicant's involvement in another case has been disclosed in para 43 of the affidavit, in which he has already been granted bail.

It has also been submitted that the co-accused Rajara, who was the executant of the sale deed has been granted bail by this court by means of an order dated 29.08.2023, passed in Criminal Misc.
Bail Application No.10768 of 2023.

entities.text:
Criminal Misc.
Bail Application No.10768 of 2023
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text:
5. Learned Counsel for the informant has vehemently opposed the bail application and he has submitted that the accused persons have cheated the informant.
6.
The learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer of the bail, but he could not dispute the aforesaid aspects of the matter.

7. Having considered the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and keeping in view the fact that even as per the F.I.R the sale deed in question was executed on 05.10.2016 and a copy of the sale deed indicates that the possession of the land in question had been delivered to the purchaser;
that the F.I.R has been filed about seven years after execution of the sale deed alleging that the informant did not get possession; that it appears that no civil proceedings for recovery on possession have been instituted to the informant, coupled with the fact that the applicant has no criminal history and he is languishing in jail since 11.07.2023, whereas the seller has already been granted bail and without making any observations which may affect the merits of the case, I am of the view that the aforesaid facts are sufficient for making out a case for enlargement of the applicant on bail.
8. Accordingly, this bail application stands allowed.

9. Let the applicant- Anuj Tiwari be released on bail in the aforesaid case, on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of Magistrate/Court concerned,
subject to the following conditions: -
(i) the applicant shall not tamper with the prosecution evidence;
(ii) the applicant shall not pressurize the prosecution witnesses;
(iii) the applicant shall appear on each and every date fixed by the trial court.
.
(Subhash Vidyarthi,J.) Order Date :- 19.9.2023 Ram.
